verdict.rationale: Installed plugins add skills and MCP tools to ChatGPT Chat/Work and Codex sessions, where users direct them conversationally. Examples include summarizing Slack channels, drafting replies, working across Drive, and sending messages. The built-in plugin-creator skill also builds skills through a conversational Q&A. However, installing and managing plugins relies on slash commands and `$` mentions (`/plugins`, `$skill-installer`, `codex plugin marketplace add`) rather than free-form language. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the plugins themselves can be installed and configured purely by natural-language requests, and independent hands-on reports of natural-language operation of specific plugins.
